_comment: Anti-regrowth ratchet baseline for tool/metrics_ratchet_check.dart. Counts = number of functions whose dart_code_linter metric level is 'warning' or 'alarm', per metric, over lib/ after the analysis_options.yaml metrics-exclude. Captured 2026-05-22 against origin/master by running `dart run dart_code_linter:metrics analyze lib/ --reporter=json`. The ratchet only tightens: LOWER these as the refactor phase reduces violations; raising any value needs explicit operator approval (CLAUDE.md 'Ceiling-raise rule R-2'). 2026-05-22 reconciliation: cyclomatic-complexity 261->262 with explicit operator approval. The +1 was pre-existing drift from operator-web PRs #1185-#1198 (merged after the 261 capture at #1183) that did not refresh this file; verified against clean origin/master (262 with and without UX-parity PR #1201), so NOT introduced by the alignment work. To be ratcheted back DOWN as the admin<->operator alignment slices adopt shared widgets and reduce per-function complexity. See runbooks/dart_code_metrics_runbook.md.
